author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia has opened a developer training center in Bangkok focused on GPU programming. The facility will offer practical courses covering parallel computing and application optimization.

The first classes are scheduled for October. Students will work on local training systems and complete supervised programming exercises before receiving course completion certificates.

The center will publish its class timetable and enrollment instructions before teaching begins.
headline: Nvidia Opens GPU Developer Training Center In Bangkok
summary: Nvidia has opened a Bangkok training center, with its first GPU programming courses scheduled for October.
